steps.title: Download Ghostline
steps.subtitle: Choose installer or standalone portable package
steps.details: Download `Ghostline-Setup.exe` for standard Windows installation or `Ghostline-Portable.zip` if you prefer a self-contained archive without administrative installation.
tips: Windows SmartScreen notice: Because open-source builds are unsigned, click 'More info' -> 'Run anyway'.

steps.title: Install Ollama (Offline Mode)
steps.subtitle: Local LLM runtime for 100% private inference
steps.details: Ollama runs powerful AI models completely on your local machine with 0 external network requests. Alternatively, you can download the installer directly from ollama.com.
tips: If you prefer cloud models (OpenAI, Gemini, Groq, Claude), you can skip Ollama and enter your API keys under Settings -> AI Provider.

steps.title: Pull a Recommended Model
steps.subtitle: Download high-speed quantized reasoning weights
steps.details: Microsoft's `phi3:mini` (3.8B parameters) offers exceptional reasoning speed, high accuracy on multiple-choice questions, and runs on CPU or GPU with only ~4GB RAM footprint.

steps.title: Launch Ghostline & Run First Scan
steps.subtitle: Test hover question recognition
steps.details: Launch Ghostline from the Start Menu or desktop shortcut. Place your mouse cursor over any question on your screen and press `Alt + /`.
tips: Ghostline uses Windows.Media.Ocr native engine to grab the question bounding box silently.
The floating HUD will appear at the top-right corner with the answer and confidence score.

steps.title: Configure Audio & Personal Profile
steps.subtitle: Unlock live meeting copilot and personalized interview answers
steps.details: Navigate to the My Profile tab in Settings to upload your resume or enter your technical experience. In interview mode, Ghostline speaks naturally in your authentic voice.
tips: Press `Alt + A` anytime during video calls (Zoom, Teams, Meet) for live speech transcription and copilot assistance.

troubleshooting.issue: Windows SmartScreen warning appears on launch
troubleshooting.solution: Click 'More info' and then click 'Run anyway'. Ghostline is fully open source; all SHA-256 hashes are verifiable in the GitHub release.
Ensure Ollama is running in your system tray or run `ollama serve` in a terminal. Ghostline will automatically detect it when active.

troubleshooting.issue: Microphone or loopback audio not transcribing in video calls
troubleshooting.solution: Open Settings -> Audio & Hardware. Verify that your microphone and speaker devices are active in Windows Sound Settings and default sample rate is 16kHz or 48kHz.
